patterns.note: Asymmetrical, layered collage-style arrangements of images and text blocks, creating a dynamic scrapbook or mood board aesthetic.
A distinctive pairing of a bold, modern sans-serif for primary headings and a flowing, elegant serif for display text and emphasis, often with small uppercase labels.
High-contrast sections alternating between light (white/beige) and dark (black) backgrounds, punctuated by muted pastel tones within the interactive collage elements.
Scroll-triggered background transitions between solid colors and textured surfaces, combined with layered, interactive collage elements that exhibit subtle parallax and depth as the user scrolls.
Clear visual separation of content into distinct, full-width sections, each with a unique background treatment (solid color, textured surface, or interactive collage).

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-driven animation system to transition between full-width background colors and textures as the user scrolls down the page, creating distinct visual chapters.

Interactive collage elements are rendered with a 3D library (WebGL/Three.js) to create a sense of depth and subtle parallax, making them appear to float and layer over the content as the user scrolls, rather than being static images.
Text content is presented in large, high-contrast blocks, often introduced by a smaller, uppercase label, ensuring readability against the dynamically changing backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body) are paired with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels and an elegant, flowing serif for decorative emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for structural elements and text blocks, with some collage elements featuring organic, torn-paper edges or subtle rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within text blocks, creating a sense of calm and allowing the collage elements room to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of interactive, layered collage elements that float and parallax against dynamically changing backgrounds creates a highly personalized and engaging scrapbook-like experience, making it feel less like a traditional website and more like an artful, living portfolio.
